cells.gaps: No share of returns filed online is held; in August 2025 the minister said more than half of the large taxpayers concerned still did not use e-Tax.
cells.note: The finance minister's communiqué of 7 August 2025 requires large taxpayers to file and pay through e-Tax under threat of sanctions (CAF-017, CAF-016), so online filing is mandatory for some taxpayers, the top rung. Filing and payment on e-Tax since 2025 (CAF-010, CAF-011) meet the rungs below.
